notes.title: Code Arcturus v1.2.0 Patch live
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I'm proud to release the new patch for Code Arcturus that includes some optimizations and a new game mode for speedrun lovers.

[h2]New Game Mode: All levels Speedrun[/h2]
[list]
[*]After you clear the game, you'll get the option to start a new speedrun from the main menu. This will start you off on level 1 with a timer, and will continue to the end of the game. 
[*]In this game mode checkpoints are disabled. If you die, you start at the beginning of the level you're currently on, but the timer doesn't reset. Time ends after defeating the final boss.
[*]You can view the current Steam leaderboard [url=https://steamcommunity.com//stats/1264410/leaderboards/6283282]here[/url]. Try to beat the dev time ːhappymeatː
[/list]

[h2]Technical improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Unity engine updated to 2020.3 LTS
[*]Some minor engine optimizations and stability improvements
[/list]

As always, if you experience any issues, or have suggestions for further improvements, feel free to hit me up in the community tab, or on [url=https://twitter.com/eNorby]twitter[/url].

Have fun!

notes.title: Code Arcturus v1.1.0 Patch live
notes.content:
I'm happy to release the first larger patch for Code Arcturus. v1.1.0 includes:

[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Two difficulty settings added to the level selection screen: "Rebalanced" and "Original". The Rebalanced option is the new default and recommended for new players. But you are free to switch to the Original difficulty at any time, to experience the game in it's original "glory".
[*]Removed some especially annoying spike ball obstacles and enemies in level 5
[*]Lowered the spawn rate of enemies in level 6 by 50%
[*]Removed some especially annoying rocket enemies in level 7
[*]Lowered the spawn rate of enemies in level 9 by 25%
[*]Reduced the star requirement for the final boss from 25 to 20 stars
[/list]

[h3]Technical upgrade[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated the engine to Unity 2020.2.2f
[*]Various stability improvements
[/list]

If you experience any issues, or have suggestions for further improvements, feel free to let me know.

Have fun!

notes.title: Code Arcturus v1.0.2 is now live
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who tried out Code Arcturus during the last couple days since launch! Based on some of the feedback I received, the following changes have now been implemented:

[list]
[*] Invincibility frames increased by 25% (up from 1.2 to 1.5 seconds)
[*] The spikes in the first level's tap jump section have been slightly raised 
[*] Menu navigation with controller has been improved - although it's still faster to navigate with a mouse for now
[/list]

If you experience any issues, or have suggestions for further improvements, please share them on the game's community tab.

Have fun!
